fieldValues.title: Un-bake headings batch C: ext:repository, ext:json-store, ext:registry, ext:import-tracking
fieldValues.summary: Splits 30 baked headings across 4 subsections into 32 mechanism leaves. ext:repository leaves parent under the existing Repository concept; ext:json-store, ext:registry and ext:import-tracking have no existing concept, so 3 new concept records are minted (JSON Store, Registry, Import tracking). Third of four batches (#684-#687) covering #562s remaining scope.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from srs#580 gate:dispatched queue (dispatch comment 2026-09-08 ~19:15Z on #686). Claimed 2026-09-08T19:38Z. Followed carried_context-39fde6eb for the splitting algorithm. Tried the #686/#687 coordinator addendum literally first (parent each new concept under the section the source subsection sat under, here 07-extensions) and found it produces a real double-render defect in docs/spec/srs-spec.md: 15 of 32 new leaf headings rendered twice at two different depths, because a still-section-typed record already participates in a recursive contains-walk that collides with the flat mechanism discovery-query listing added by #678. Reverted the 3 section-to-concept contains edges and left the 3 new concepts as roots (matching all 53 pre-existing concept records, none of which is contains-parented today) - clean 1:1 heading diff after. Filed as finding-<see below> for #687 (batch D, not yet started) since it is the one remaining batch that would otherwise repeat the same addendum instruction verbatim. Also bundled a one-line fix to scripts/versioning-cell-allowlist.json (stale entry, confirmed pre-existing on origin/master via git stash), matching batch As (#700) independent fix of the same entry - a harmless double-fix, whichever PR merges first the other no-ops on rebase.
